candidates.snippet: Read today's update from CTP and @TheStudyofWar: https://t.co/NCxMavR6kW (3/3)

The Houthis are attacking several Yemeni government positions south and west of Taiz City in an effort to fully encircle and capture the city, while Yemeni government-aligned forces continue to stall the Houthi advances. (2/3) https://t.co/689uhLKt5m

NEW | US President Donald Trump told reporters on October 10 that he is considering whether the United States will conduct offensive strikes against the Houthis in response to recent Houthi attacks on Saudi airports and other civilian infrastructure. (1/3) https://t.co/3QFFK3oqG0
